# andesim-demo

Demo programs for the `andesim` hybrid RISC-V simulator. One ELF runs on
every mode: `fast` (QEMU), `cycle` (vsim, cycle-accurate), and `hybrid`
(QEMU fast-forwards the boot, vsim measures your region of interest).

## Prerequisites

- An `andesim` checkout, already built (`bash scripts/build_all.sh`).
  Check it with `./andesim doctor`.
- An Andes RISC-V toolchain (the one `doctor` reports).

## Step 1: Modify `Make.var`

Fill in these settings if your paths differ:

```Makefile
ANDESIM ?=            # path to the andesim checkout
TOOLCHAIN_PREFIX ?=   # e.g. .../bin/riscv64-unknown-elf-
ENGINE ?=             # cycle-accurate engine, see `andesim list engines`
```

## Step 2: Build

```bash
make
```

Each demo links against the andesim runtime
(`-B $(ANDESIM)/build/runtime -specs=andesim.specs`), so the same binary
runs on every mode -- no per-engine builds, no semihosting.

## Step 3: Run

Run every mode of one demo:

```bash
make run-hello
make run-lm
make run-lm_slave
make run-lm_dma
make run-hvm_slave
make run-hvm_dma
make run-rvv
make run-syscall
make run-coremark
make run-dhrystone
```

Or one mode at a time (the `lm-*` / `lm_slave-*` / `lm_dma-*`,
`hvm_slave-*` / `hvm_dma-*`, `rvv-*`, `syscall-*`, `coremark-*` and
`dhrystone-*` targets work the same way):

| Target                     | What it shows                                          |
|----------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------|
| `make hello-fast`          | QEMU only: program output, full speed, no cycle figure |
| `make hello-cycle`         | vsim from reset: program output + cycle figure         |
| `make hello-hybrid-marker` | hybrid, ROI marked in source with `<andesim/ROI.h>`    |
| `make hello-hybrid-pc`     | hybrid, same ROI named by symbols (`--pc-start`/`--pc-end`), no markers needed |

Two ACERVV instructions are implemented in `ace-rvv.ace`, corresponding to the following two test cases:

/* HVM through the bus subordinate port -- across the hybrid handoff.
 *
 * The HVM (High-Bandwidth Vector Memory) is the vector unit's private
 * 256 KB SRAM at 0x90000000, 2 banks (bank = address bit 17). Unlike
 * the ILM/DLM it has no enable CSR and no hart-local address: its one
 * window IS the bus subordinate port. So every access here is a plain
 * SCALAR load/store -- on the RTL it leaves the hart's bus master port,
 * is routed by the interconnect, and enters the HVM through that
 * subordinate port, the same port an external master would use
 * (demo/hvm_dma makes that literal).
 *
 * QEMU phase (before the ROI):
 *   - scalar-fill the whole 256 KB with a runtime-computed pattern
 *   - sanity: read head and tail back
 *
 * vsim ROI:
 *   - scalar-read every 64th word plus the words a bank-split bug would
 *     hit (bank0 head/tail, bank1 head/tail; bank = address bit 17),
 *     compare; prints HVM_SLV_OK / HVM_SLV_BAD
 *
 * The pattern reaches the RTL's HVM SRAM only via the sidecar transport
 * (plugin drain -> <state>.hvm -> vsim backdoor load); QEMU's HVM RAM
 * is not backed by the shared DRAM mmap.
 *
 * Geometry matches vsim:ax45mpv_premium: HVM 256 KB at 0x90000000.
 */

#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <andesim/ROI.h>

#define HVM_BASE   0x90000000u
#define HVM_BYTES  262144u
#define HVM_WORDS  (HVM_BYTES / 4u)
#define STRIDE     64u

static inline uint32_t pat(uint32_t i) { return i * 2654435761u + 0x5B33u; }

static uint32_t check_word(uint32_t i)
{
  volatile uint32_t *hvm = (volatile uint32_t *) (uintptr_t) HVM_BASE;
  return hvm[i] != pat(i);
}

/* ROI body, noinline and non-static so --trigger pc can name it. */
__attribute__((noinline)) int hslv_check(void)
{
  uint32_t bad = 0, checked = 0;

  for (uint32_t i = 0; i < HVM_WORDS; i += STRIDE) {
    bad += check_word(i);
    checked++;
  }
  /* Bank boundary and tails: bank0 = words [0, 32768), bank1 = the rest. */
  static const uint32_t spots[3] = {HVM_WORDS / 2u - 1u, HVM_WORDS / 2u,
                                    HVM_WORDS - 1u};
  for (int s = 0; s < 3; s++) {
    bad += check_word(spots[s]);
    checked++;

/* HVM through the bus subordinate port -- across the hybrid handoff.
 *
 * The HVM (High-Bandwidth Vector Memory) is the vector unit's private
 * 256 KB SRAM at 0x90000000, 2 banks (bank = address bit 17). Unlike
 * the ILM/DLM it has no enable CSR and no hart-local address: its one
 * window IS the bus subordinate port. So every access here is a plain
 * SCALAR load/store -- on the RTL it leaves the hart's bus master port,
 * is routed by the interconnect, and enters the HVM through that
 * subordinate port, the same port an external master would use
 * (demo/hvm_dma makes that literal).
 *
 * QEMU phase (before the ROI):
 *   - scalar-fill the whole 256 KB with a runtime-computed pattern
 *   - sanity: read head and tail back
 *
 * vsim ROI:
 *   - scalar-read every 64th word plus the words a bank-split bug would
 *     hit (bank0 head/tail, bank1 head/tail; bank = address bit 17),
 *     compare; prints HVM_SLV_OK / HVM_SLV_BAD
 *
 * The pattern reaches the RTL's HVM SRAM only via the sidecar transport
 * (plugin drain -> <state>.hvm -> vsim backdoor load); QEMU's HVM RAM
 * is not backed by the shared DRAM mmap.
 *
 * Geometry matches vsim:ax45mpv_premium: HVM 256 KB at 0x90000000.
 */

#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <andesim/ROI.h>

#define HVM_BASE   0x90000000u
#define HVM_BYTES  262144u
#define HVM_WORDS  (HVM_BYTES / 4u)
#define STRIDE     64u

static inline uint32_t pat(uint32_t i) { return i * 2654435761u + 0x5B33u; }

static uint32_t check_word(uint32_t i)
{
  volatile uint32_t *hvm = (volatile uint32_t *) (uintptr_t) HVM_BASE;
  return hvm[i] != pat(i);
}

/* ROI body, noinline and non-static so --trigger pc can name it. */
__attribute__((noinline)) int hslv_check(void)
{
  uint32_t bad = 0, checked = 0;

  for (uint32_t i = 0; i < HVM_WORDS; i += STRIDE) {
    bad += check_word(i);
    checked++;
  }
  /* Bank boundary and tails: bank0 = words [0, 32768), bank1 = the rest. */
  static const uint32_t spots[3] = {HVM_WORDS / 2u - 1u, HVM_WORDS / 2u,
                                    HVM_WORDS - 1u};
  for (int s = 0; s < 3; s++) {
    bad += check_word(spots[s]);
    checked++;
  }
